list.confirmOnchainContent: This creates a durable V2 outbox submission. The backend will re-check your account, roles, permission, project identity, trusted runtime, and active reorg fence inside the mutation transaction.
list.confirmCancelOnchainContent: Project "{name}" (#{id}) will be cancelled on-chain and settled as Canceled: contributors can refund, the project owner can withdraw all deposited tokens, and purchases stop permanently. This cannot be undone.
list.confirmFeeWithdrawContent: This transfers the success fee (total raised x fee rate) of project "{name}" (#{id}) from contract escrow to the platform fee receiver. The transfer is irreversible.
list.pauseScopeHint: Applies globally to the IDO V2 contract: while paused no project can be purchased/activated/funded; refunds and claims are unaffected
list.pauseAlready: Contract is already paused; no action needed
list.unpauseAlready: Contract is already resumed; no action needed
list.confirmPauseContent: This calls pause() on the contract and affects every project: purchases, activations and token deposits are blocked; user refunds and claims are unaffected.
list.confirmUnpauseContent: This calls unpause() on the contract to resume purchases, activations and token deposits for all projects.
list.confirmRestoreContent: Project {name} will be re-enabled and shown in client launchpad lists again.
list.confirmDisableContent: Project {name} will be set to Archived and hidden from client launchpad lists.
list.confirmDeleteContent: Project {name} and its updates, subscriptions, watches, whitelist and display files will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
list.popupBlocked: Popup blocked, please open it manually
list.restoreBlockedV2Stablecoin: On-chain managed project cannot be restored
list.restoreBlockedActiveSubmission: There is a pending on-chain submission, cannot be restored
list.restoreBlockedLegacyNoSourceStatus: Legacy project has no source status before archiving, cannot be restored
list.fairLaunchDepositOwnerOnly: Project Token deposit must be signed by projectOwner; Admin never signs or deposits on their behalf

errors.reserveInsufficientGeneric: Insufficient project token reserve. Please top up project tokens and retry.
errors.reserveInsufficientSuffix: Please top up project tokens and retry
